authLayout.tagline: Private, invite‑only nutrition tracking. Your data stays yours.

welcome.heroSubtitle: A private, invite‑only meal logging platform for people who take their health seriously — without sharing a single calorie with advertisers, coaches, or social networks.
welcome.dashboardPreview: Real dashboard preview — your macros, your privacy.
welcome.featuresSubtitle: FitCheck is focused on one thing: private, accurate, insightful nutrition tracking for one person — you.
welcome.feature1Desc: Build your own personal food database with nutrition values per 100 g. Editable anytime — it's yours, and only yours.
welcome.feature2Desc: Save your go‑to meals as reusable templates. Log a full breakfast or post‑workout shake in two taps.
welcome.feature3Desc: Describe what you ate in plain language — "a bowl of lentil soup and a slice of bread" — and let the AI estimate and log it for you.
welcome.feature4Desc: Set your own calorie, protein, carb, fat, sugar, and fiber goals. The dashboard shows exactly how close you are — no generic RDA.
welcome.feature5Desc: See 7‑day and 30‑day trends for every macro. Spot patterns, adjust your targets, and stay on track over time.
welcome.feature6Desc: No global food DB, no social sharing, no coaches peeking. Every record is scoped to your account. Privacy by design.
welcome.closingTitle: Ready to take control of your nutrition — privately?
welcome.closingSubtitle: FitCheck is invite‑only by design. Your data is yours, your insights are personal, and your tracking is invisible to everyone else.
